turns.text: What were gross sales by store for the second quarter of 2026, counting each sale at the store that fulfilled it?
{"sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) as total_pos, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as orders FROM pos_sales WHERE sold_on >= '2026-04-01' AND sold_on <= '2026-06-30'"}
turns.name: run_sql

turns.text: {"sql": "SELECT p.store as pos_store, f.shipped_from, COUNT(*) FROM pos_sales p LEFT JOIN fulfillment f ON p.order_id = f.order_id WHERE p.sold_on >= '2026-04-01' AND p.sold_on <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.store, f.shipped_from ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20"}
turns.name: run_sql

turns.text:
{"sql": "
SELECT f.shipped_from as store, sm.name as store_name, 
       ROUND(SUM(p.qty * p.unit_price),2) as gross_sales,
       COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM pos_sales p
JOIN fulfillment f ON p.order_id = f.order_id
LEFT JOIN store_map sm ON f.shipped_from = sm.store
WHERE p.sold_on >= '2026-04-01' AND p.sold_on <= '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY f.shipped_from, sm.name
ORDER BY f.shipped_from
"}
turns.name: run_sql

turns.text: {"sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pos_sales p LEFT JOIN fulfillment f ON p.order_id=f.order_id WHERE p.sold_on >= '2026-04-01' AND p.sold_on <= '2026-06-30' AND f.order_id IS NULL"}
turns.name: run_sql

turns.text:
Q2 2026 (April 1 to June 30, 2026, based on sale date), gross sales attributed to the store that fulfilled each order (using the fulfillment table's shipped_from, joined by order_id to pos_sales), computed as sum of qty × unit_price:

- S1 (Harbor): $30,141.49
- S2 (Midtown): $31,070.58
- S3 (Eastgate): $28,051.85
- S4 (Northside): $30,963.64
- Total: $120,227.56

Note: this differs slightly from summing by the store recorded on the pos_sales line itself, since 34 lines were sold by one store but shipped from another (cross-store fulfillment). All 922 Q2 order lines matched to a fulfillment record, so the totals are complete.
